fullDescription: A dark, premium mobile landing page design system named 'Café Reset'. It features a sophisticated 'coffee-inspired' color palette of deep blacks, warm golds, and cream accents. The aesthetic combines wellness and fintech sensibilities, utilizing editorial-grade typography (Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi) and high-contrast visuals. Suitable for high-ticket digital products, wellness protocols, biohacking apps, and premium lifestyle services. Layout features high-impact hero sections, emotional storytelling cards, bento-style trust grids, and data-visualization graphs.

structured.summary: A high-conversion, mobile-optimized premium dark mode design. It uses an emotional narrative structure (pain points, mechanism, solution) supported by warm metallic accents, glowing cards, and smooth micro-interactions to create a sense of authority and luxury.

style.description: Premium dark mode with a 'warm metallic' theme. Typography uses a pairing of bold, high-character Grotesk for headlines and clean, legible sans-serif for body text. Colors are centered around deep ink tones and warm gold/coffee accents with subtle glows and grain textures. Animations are organic and focused on upward motion ('rise') and shimmer effects.
style.prompt:
### Visual Theme
- **Base Background**: Deep Ink (#0f0f0f to #1a1a1a).
- **Primary Accents**: Gold (#d4a574), Coffee Brown (#8b6f47), Cream (#f5f1e8).
- **Borders**: 1px solid with low opacity (e.g., Cream at 10% or Gold at 18%).
- **Shadows**: 
  - `shadow-glow`: 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,165,116,0.18), 0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,0.65).
  - `shadow-card`: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245,241,232,0.08), 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55).

### Typography
- **Headlines**: Cabinet Grotesk (Weights: 600, 700). Tracking: -0.02em. Line-height: 1.06.
- **Body Text**: Satoshi (Weights: 400, 500). Size: 14px-15px. Line-height: 1.6.
- **Badges**: Monospace or small caps Satoshi. Tracking: 0.18em.

### Animations
- **Rise**: `translateY(10px)` to `0` with `opacity: 0` to `1`. Duration: 0.55s, timing: ease-out.
- **Button Shimmer**: 2.6s infinite sweep of a 50% width white/20% opacity block at -12deg skew.
- **Transitions**: CSS View Transitions for smooth page/state fades (0.25s duration).

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is a single-column mobile-first stack utilizing rounded cards (3xl, 24px-32px radius) to isolate narrative beats. It follows an 'AIDA' plus 'Mechanism' marketing structure.

prompts.prompt: Sticky-capable bar. Left side: Logo image (height 36px) paired with a stacked text label (14px title, 12px subtitle at 65% opacity). Right side: Action button (height 44px, rounded-xl, Gold background, dark text).

A 3xl rounded card containing: 1. A small badge (pill-shaped, gold border, 12px text). 2. A massive headline (32px, Cabinet Grotesk). 3. Emotional body text with highlighted span in Cream. 4. A primary 'Shimmer' CTA button (height 56px, Gold). 5. A secondary borderless button with an arrow icon. 6. A 3-column trust grid (icon + small text) at the bottom.

Detailed explanation card. Title: 20px Grotesk. Structure: Narrative paragraphs followed by a 'Cycle Visual' block. The cycle visual is a vertical list of 4 items, each with a 40px icon box (Gold/Ink blend) and a title/description pair, connected conceptually to show flow.

Two-card comparison. 'Before' card: Dark, subtle 28% opacity cream stroke for a spiky, erratic line graph. 'After' card: Glowing gold stroke (95% opacity) for a smooth, stable sine-wave line graph. SVG paths should be 4px wide with rounded caps.

A visual representation of a digital protocol as a physical kit. Uses a nested card layout. Inner element: A 7x3 grid of small rounded squares (simulating a calendar) with varying gold opacities to show progress. Below it, a checklist with icons (Timing, Shield, Zap) and time-stamps (e.g., '90 min').

prompts.prompt: High-urgency card with a gradient background (Ink-850 to Ink-900). Features a 24px headline, a primary shimmer button, a secondary 'learn more' button, and a 'Guarantee Box' at the bottom featuring a shield icon and policy text.

special_ui_components.description: A high-impact gold button with a moving light reflection.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: #d4a574; Text: #0f0f0f; Height: 56px; Radius: 16px; Font: Cabinet Grotesk; Overflow: Hidden; Pseudo-element: A white 20% opacity rectangle, 50% width, -12deg skew, animating from left: -140% to 240% over 2.6s.

Positions: Top-center, Left-mid, Right-bottom. Shapes: Circles (64px-80px). Blur: 3xl (64px+). Color: Gold (#d4a574) or Coffee (#8b6f47) at 10-12% opacity. Add a subtle dot-grid overlay (18px spacing, 8% opacity) on top.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use 'view-transition-name: main-content' for seamless scrolling. MUST: Keep background blurs (3xl) in gold/coffee tones very subtle (opacity 10-12%). MUST: Ensure all buttons have an active:translate-y-[1px] micro-interaction. DO NOT: Use pure #000 black; use #0f0f0f for better depth. DO NOT: Use standard blue or green for positive indicators; stick to Gold (#d4a574).
